options: A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
questions.solution:
For Assertion: The acetals are unstable in the presence of aqueous solutions of acid because they undergo hydrolysis in the presence of acidic conditions to produce the parent aldehyde or ketone or alcohols. But are stable and do not undergo hydrolysis in the presence of a base or under neutral conditions.

Hence assertion is correct.

For reason: Alkoxide ion (RO–) is not considered a good leaving group

Hence reason must be false.

So, the correct option is A

Some reactions of NO2 relevant to photochemical smog formation are

Identify A,B,X and Y
questions.solution:
When fossil fuels are burnt, a variety of pollutants are emitted into the earth’s troposphere. Two of the pollutants that are emitted are hydrocarbons (unburnt fuels) and nitric oxide (NO). When these pollutants build up to sufficiently high levels, a chain reaction occurs from their interaction with sunlight in which NO is converted into nitrogen dioxide NO2. This NO2 in turn absorbs energy from sunlight and breaks up into nitric oxide and a free oxygen atom.

NO2 (g) →hν NO (g) + O(g)

Oxygen atoms are very reactive and combine with the O2 in air to produce ozone.

O (g) + O2 (g) ⇌ O3 (g)

Hence, X = O, Y = NO, A = O2, B = O3

questions.chapter: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals
questions.q: Which one of the following reactions does not occur during extraction of copper ?
questions.solution:
The following changes occur during smelting.

(a) Most of the ferrous sulphide gets oxidised to ferrous oxide which combines with silica (flux) to form fusible slag.

2FeS + 3O2 → 2FeO + 2SO2

FeO + SiO2 → FeSiO3 (Ferrous silicate)

The slag being lighter floats and forms the upper layer. It is removed through the slag hole from time to time.

(b) During roasting or in the blast furnace if any oxide of copper is formed, it combines with FeS and is changed back into its sulphide.

2Cu2S + 3O2 → 2Cu2O + 2SO2

Cu2O + FeS → Cu2S + FeO

Ferrous oxide thus formed again combines with silica to form more slag.

FeO+SiO2→FeSiO3

So, no formation of calcium silicate CaSiO3 in extraction of Cu.

questions.q: All electromagnetic wave is transporting energy in the negative <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>z</mi></math> direction. At a certain point and certain time the direction of electric field of the wave is along positive <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi></math> direction. What will be the direction of the magnetic field of the wave at that point and instant?
questions.solution:
In an electromagnetic wave, the direction of energy flow is along the direction of the wave propagation. Therefore, the wave propagates along negative z direction. 

Electric field is along the positive y direction and the wave propagates along negative z direction. Thus, magnetic field is in direction perpendicular to both z and y axes. 

Using vector algebra, 

(-k^)=(+j^)×i^

Hence, magnetic field is in positive x direction.

Using equation of motion, s=uxt+12axt2  along x direction, we get

Using equation of motion, vy=uy+ayt along y direction, we get

From equation 1 and 2, we have

vy=eEm10-1ux

Now, tanθ=vyvx=eEm10-1ux2=e×10×10-1m×em=1

The angle of deviation of the path of electron as it comes out of the field is θ=45°.

questions.q:
Assume that the earth is a solid sphere of uniform density and a tunnel is dug along its diameter throughout the earth. It is found that when a particle is released in this tunnel, it executes a simple harmonic motion. The mass of the particle is 100 g. The time period of the motion of the particle will be (approximately)

(take g=10 ms-2, radius of earth =6400 km)
questions.solution:
The gravitational force acting on a particle of mass m at a distance r (<R) from the centre of Earth is

F=-GM'mr2  ....(1)

where M' is the mass of portion of Earth enclosed by a sphere of radius r concentric with Earth. Here - sign indicates radially inward direction of force.

Taking the density of Earth to be uniform

M'4πr3=M4πR3

⇒M'=Mr3R3   ....(2)

Substituting M' from equation 2 into equation 1:

F=-GMmR3 r

Which is similar to the equation of motion F=-kx with k=GMmR3=mgR (∵g=GMR2)

For such motion, the time period is given by:

T=2πmk

Substituting k from above,

T=2πRg

Putting the values, we get

T=2×3.146400×10310=2×3.14×800≈1 hour 24 minutes

Then, the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> will be:
questions.solution:
Time period of a simple pendulum at Earth's surface is given by

T=2πlg.

When distance from centre of Earth, i.e., at h=R, acceleration due to gravity is g'=g1+hR2=g22=g4

Now, time period is  xT=2πlg4

⇒xT=2×2πlg

⇒xT=2T⇒x=2

Thus, x=2.

questions.q:
Given below are two statements : one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R

Assertion A: Photodiodes are used in forward bias usually for measuring the light intensity.

Reason R: For a p-n junction diode, at applied voltage V the current in the forward bias is more than the current in the reverse bias for Vz>±V≥V0 where V0 is the threshold voltage and Vz is the breakdown voltage.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below
options: Both A and R are true and R is correct explanation A
Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation A
A is false but R is true
A is true but R is false
questions.solution:
Photodiodes are operated in reverse bias condition. The change in saturation reverse current in a photodiode with reverse bias is directly proportional to the change in light intensity, thus can be precisely measured.

Current in forward bias (for applied voltageV≥V0) is always greater than current in reverse bias (for V≤Vz ) in a p-n junction diode.

Hence, Assertion if false but Reason is true.

questions.q: An object of mass m initially at rest on a smooth horizontal plane starts moving under the action of force F=2 N. In the process of its linear motion, the angle θ (as shown in figure) between the direction of force and horizontal varies as θ=kx, where k is a constant and x is the distance covered by the object from its initial position. The expression of kinetic energy of the object will be E=nksin θ. The value of n is ______.
questions.solution:
As seen in the free body diagram of the object, normal force N, weight mg and force in parallel and perpendicular directions are acting.

Using Newton's law of motion

Along horizontal direction, Fcosθ=ma

⇒2cos(kx)=mvdvdx

Integrating the above relation, we have

∫0vvdv=2∫0xcos(kx)dx

⇒mv22=2ksinkx

Thus, kinetic energy of the object will be K.E.=2ksinθ

Thus, the value of n=2.
